slots.name: FEEL LIKE OUTRO
songs: I Guess I Just Feel Like (outro fuzz)
slots.tone_target: EPIPHONE CASINO P-90 -> BC109 silicon fuzz family -> cranked Fender Vibro Champ, low-fi warmly clipped vocal sustain with rolled-off highs.
slots.preferred_pickup_or_guitar: Closest: Epiphone Casino P-90 neck; on Strat use neck pickup with tone rolled down ~4–6 and apply post EQ shaping
slots.amp_gain_policy: first choose correctly captured gain; then adjust Amp Gain ≤±0.7 if necessary
slots.notes: High priority: do NOT use Sinewave clean as primary. The documented Shin-ei Psychedelic Machine offers fuzz, vibe, octavia, but there is no confirmed evidence all were active. Start fuzz ON, Octavia and Vibe OFF. Capture should already sound broken up. Not a Big Muff or Cornish NG-2 tone. A/B against alternate silicon and Muffin, record short DI loops.
